lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Y2Mg12 (SrYMg6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg, Sr, and Y centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Sr, and Mg–Y geometric coordination environments spanning neighbor distances of about 3.00–3.20 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations among 12-vertex Mg-centered coordination polyhedra include corner, edge, and face contacts.
